params.body:
## What Ilse saw

Opening "Nieuwe gebruiker" on a dealer sheet showed the label "Herhaal paswoord" above nothing, and the user could not be saved (the confirmation is required, R P2-2.2).

## Cause

The Tailwind rebuild of the user form (2026-09-13) wrote the confirmation field as `<x-ui.password ... @if(!is_null($user->id)) disabled @endif ...>`. Blade compiles component tags before directives, and the ComponentTagCompiler does not match a tag with a directive between its attributes: the tag stayed in the HTML as `<x-ui.password ...>`, an element no browser draws. No error, no 500, just a gap under a label, on the create modal, the create page and the edit modal alike.

## Fix

- `settings/user/_tabs/form.blade.php`: `disabled` is a bound attribute (`:disabled="!is_null($user->id)"`), written only when true.
- The same class of error sat in the rights matrix (`settings/access/edit.blade.php`, `child.blade.php`) since 2026-09-14: a single quote inside a single-quoted `onchange` and a bare `{{ $disabled }}` in the checkbox tag meant every editable row rendered without checkboxes. The `onchange` is now double-quoted with single-quoted JavaScript strings, `disabled` is bound. Verified locally: 40 checkboxes with a working `onchange`, zero leftover tags.
- `CompiledViewsTest::test_no_component_tag_survives_compilation_as_text`: any compiled view that still carries a `<x-` tag as text fails the build. `php -l` and the directive test both passed on these views. This is what found the rights matrix.
- `UserPasswordFieldsTest` (R P2-2.12, R P2-2.2): both fields present on the create modal, the create page and the edit modal (disabled until Reset); a new user with matching passwords is saved from the modal route; a mismatch and a missing confirmation are a 422 on the field.
- Rule R P2-2.12 in `32-p2-mijn-garage.md`; finding `bevindingen/2026-09-18-nieuwe-gebruiker-herhaal-paswoord-veld-ontbreekt.md` (ernst nu, opgelost).

Reproduced and verified in the browser at 1440 and 390: mismatch shows "bevestigen" under the password field, a match saves the user and reloads the sheet as before. No hot shared files touched; `refresh.css` is not involved.
params.title: User form: bring back the repeat-password field; guard against component tags left as text
